observations.row_balance: 8F41: 送る button width is only 68px vs Cancel text's 45px (~1.5x) and Edit's 25px — it reads as only modestly emphasized for what should be the primary action, closer in scale to the plain-text controls next to it. C29D: 送る button width is 96px (~2.1x Cancel, ~3.8x Edit) with clearly larger internal padding — it reads as the dominant, intentionally weighted control, which better matches its role as the primary action.
observations.content_lost: None. A pixel diff of the two images shows the only differing region is the button row itself (x:309-517, y:192-224); every other element — '# Slack' header, title 'このメッセージを送りますか？', '外部に出る' link, 宛先/差出人 fields, the message body text, and the 出所 row with its chevron — is pixel-identical between the two images.

why.primary_action_salience: C29D's 送る button is measurably wider (96px vs 68px) with generous internal padding, making it read unmistakably as the main action rather than just another same-sized element in the row.
why.error_prevention: The Edit-to-送る gap is identical in both (24px), but C29D's larger, more visually distinct button footprint makes the primary target easier to acquire correctly and less likely to be confused with the adjacent text controls at a glance.
why.control_visibility: Cancel and Edit are pixel-identical in both images (same text, size, and position offset by the button's width), and 送る is clearly legible in both — all three options are equally discoverable.
why.visual_craft: C29D's button padding follows more conventional, comfortable button proportions; 8F41's tighter padding makes the pill shape feel slightly cramped relative to its corner radius.
why.overall: C29D keeps identical content everywhere else but gives the send button more appropriate visual weight for a primary/destructive-adjacent action, which reads as the more deliberate, better-crafted choice.
